'''Wirt-cough''' was a disease that caused an epidemic sometime around [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The disease originated in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], then it spread to the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]] and eventually the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
